fields.mechanism: Interlocking structural elements from aerospace fastening systems
fields.intervention: Flow diverter with mechanical interlocking segments that maintain position without compromising flexibility
fields.expected_effect: Prevention of device migration and component separation while maintaining flow diversion
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated mechanical stress testing with dynamic flow conditions to evaluate interlock integrity
fields.mechanism_source_span: "If coil embolization within an aneurysm is difficult, stenting alone may also be an effective treatment."

fields.mechanism: Passive structural support without active elements to maintain vessel patency
fields.intervention: Design a flow diverter with passive structural reinforcements that maintain vessel patency without requiring active engagement with vessel walls
fields.expected_effect: The passive structural reinforcement prevents device migration and maintains function under physiological conditions without introducing new failure modes
fields.falsification_test: Test passive reinforced flow diverters in simulated environments with varying flow dynamics and compare migration rates and structural integrity to standard diverters
fields.mechanism_source_span: "If coil embolization within an aneurysm is difficult, stenting alone may also be an effective treatment."

fields.mechanism: Single stenting provides structural support to the vessel wall and promotes endothelialization over the aneurysm neck
fields.intervention: Incorporate a self-expanding stent design with radial force distribution to reinforce the flow diverter structure at potential damage points
fields.expected_effect: Enhanced structural integrity at critical junction points while maintaining flow diversion capability, reducing the incidence of device damage prior to use
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated fatigue testing of the reinforced flow diverter under simulated physiological conditions, comparing failure rates against original design
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Single stenting was performed on day 20, and an additional stenting was performed on day 26 due to postoperative stent migration. At six months post-operation, DSA revealed that the aneurysm had disappeared"

fields.mechanism: Single stenting provides structural reinforcement to the vessel wall, preventing rebleeding while maintaining blood flow through the vessel
fields.intervention: Incorporate a reinforced braided mesh structure within the flow diverter that provides additional radial strength while maintaining porosity for flow diversion
fields.expected_effect: The reinforced structure would resist deformation and damage during deployment and use, preventing the defective component failures while maintaining flow diversion function
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated durability testing under simulated physiological conditions with high-flow scenarios and mechanical stress to evaluate resistance to deformation and damage
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Single stenting was performed on day 20, and an additional stenting was performed on day 26 due to postoperative stent migration. At six months post-operation, DSA revealed that the aneurysm had disappeared, and the patient was recovering well."

fields.mechanism: Stenting provides structural reinforcement to weakened vessel walls while maintaining blood flow through the stent lumen, preventing aneurysm reformation without introducing new failure modes
fields.intervention: Incorporate a reinforced mesh structure within the flow diverter that provides radial strength to support damaged vessel walls while maintaining open flow channels
fields.expected_effect: The reinforced mesh would prevent device deformation under physiological conditions while maintaining flow diversion function, addressing the defective component and device damage issues
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated fatigue testing of reinforced flow diverters under pulsatile flow conditions simulating vessel damage scenarios, measuring structural integrity and flow diversion efficiency over extended periods
